item: kit atlas contact sheet, batch 1b, at phone size (tools/ui_gate/sheet.py)
critique: Discs, pills and tags carry all four layers (top-lit body gradient, gloss band on the top third, dark hue-matched rim, solid darker lip); panel_glass has a gold bevelled frame around a dark inner well; nothing bands at 60 pt; the high-contrast twins are opaque with a light ~3 pt outline and a drop (ruling v2). Weaker points: 'disc box disabled' is a near-flat fill (a disabled state, not a primary control), and panel_glass's gold frame is flatter than the anchor's bevel.

item: kit atlas contact sheet, batch 1b, at phone size (tools/ui_gate/sheet.py)
critique: Each hue keeps one role: red for alarm and badge (with a notch or stripe), gold only as the selected-rim material, orange with hatching for warn, teal with hatching and a lock for locked, violet for the base controls; every state also has a shape, so it survives grayscale and high contrast, and the controls stand off their ground in value. Kit-1's sand-gold and teal-focus notes do not recur here. Close calls: the bronze-ish panel_glass rim reads as frame material, and the locked teal sits near a cyan school hue.
